description: List every configured schedule and every persisted action definition, actual process mechanism, destination and messaging-owner observation. The optional status filter applies after enumeration. complete=true requires exhausted valid paging and stable persistent/memory registry epochs; incomplete results retain known rows and advisories. Execution session_id/flow_id are context, never inferred destinations.
embedding_description: List every configured schedule with complete copied action definitions, target mechanism and owner lifecycle observations. Inspect revision, runtime job status, checked registry epochs and completeness advisories. Optional status filtering preserves the completeness of the underlying owner enumeration.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: List every configured schedule and every persisted action definition, actual process mechanism, destination and messaging-owner observation. The optional status filter applies after enumeration. complete=true requires exhausted valid paging and stable persistent/memory registry epochs; incomplete results retain known rows and advisories. Execution session_id/flow_id are context, never inferred destinations.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show completeness, holder observation, revision and activation advisories explicitly. A registered route is an observation, not a delivery guarantee.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Read current revision before a mutation. Recovery is a separate explicit action. Pre-boundary queued work is unchanged.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: A stale revision or invalid lifecycle transition is a data-integrity refusal; unavailable observations are advisories.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read the current owner projection and history, then make an explicit correction with its current revision. Do not recreate a schedule to bypass a stale revision.
